# Setup

The pipeline R scripts are run with a dedicated test conda environment
(`tests/.env`, created once), so the R used to render this document only needs
`knitr`, `rmarkdown`, `data.table` & `Matrix`.

```{r environment}
PROJECT_DIR = normalizePath(".")
BIN_RP = file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "subworkflows/local/reads_processing/bin")
BIN_IQ = file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "subworkflows/local/isoform_quantification/bin")
ENV_DIR = file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "tests/.env")
OUTDIR = file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "tests/results")
TMP = file.path(tempdir(), "scalpel_tests")
dir.create(TMP, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

#- tools...
stopifnot(nzchar(Sys.which("nextflow")), nzchar(Sys.which("conda")))
message("nextflow: ", system("nextflow -version 2>&1 | grep -o 'version [0-9.]*'", intern = TRUE))

#- test conda environment (R packages used by the pipeline scripts)...
if(!dir.exists(ENV_DIR)){
  message("Creating test conda environment (first run only)...")
  status = system2("conda", c(
    "create", "-y", "-q", "-p", ENV_DIR, "--override-channels", "-c", "conda-forge", "-c", "bioconda",
    "r-base=4.4.3", "r-argparse=2.3.1", "r-data.table=1.17.8", "r-dplyr=1.1.4", "r-fst=0.9.8",
    "r-tidyr=1.3.2", "r-ggplot2=3.5.1", "r-scales=1.3.0", "r-matrix=1.7_6", "r-r.utils=2.13.0",
    "r-stringr=1.5.1"
  ))
  stopifnot(status == 0)
}
RSCRIPT = file.path(ENV_DIR, "bin/Rscript")
SAMTOOLS = file.path(ENV_DIR, "bin/samtools")
if(!file.exists(SAMTOOLS)){
  stopifnot(system2("conda", c("install", "-y", "-q", "-p", ENV_DIR, "--override-channels", "-c", "conda-forge", "-c", "bioconda", "samtools=1.25")) == 0)
}
if(!dir.exists(file.path(ENV_DIR, "lib/R/library/GenomicRanges"))){
  stopifnot(system2("conda", c("install", "-y", "-q", "-p", ENV_DIR, "--override-channels", "-c", "conda-forge", "-c", "bioconda", "bioconductor-genomicranges=1.58.0")) == 0)
}

#- helpers...
run_pipeline = function(name, extra_args, samplesheet = "tests/data/light/samplesheet.csv", profile = "test,conda"){
  log_file = file.path(TMP, paste0(name, ".log"))
  status = system2(
    "nextflow",
    c("run", PROJECT_DIR, "-profile", profile, "--outdir", file.path(TMP, name), "-resume",
      "--samplesheet", normalizePath(samplesheet), extra_args),
    stdout = log_file, stderr = log_file, env = "NXF_ANSI_LOG=false"
  )
  return(list(status = status, log = readLines(log_file), outdir = file.path(TMP, name)))
}
read_idge = function(idge_dir){
  m = readMM(file.path(idge_dir, "matrix.mtx.gz"))
  rownames(m) = fread(file.path(idge_dir, "features.tsv.gz"), header = FALSE)$V1
  #- barcodes without 10x '-1' suffix (comparison with Drop-seq barcodes)...
  colnames(m) = sub("-1$", "", fread(file.path(idge_dir, "barcodes.tsv.gz"), header = FALSE)$V1)
  return(as.matrix(m)[order(rownames(m)), order(colnames(m)), drop = FALSE])
}
same_idge = function(dir_a, dir_b){
  a = read_idge(dir_a)
  b = read_idge(dir_b)
  return(identical(dim(a), dim(b)) && identical(dimnames(a), dimnames(b)) && max(abs(a - b)) < 1e-9)
}
run_rscript = function(args, log_file){
  status = system2(RSCRIPT, args, stdout = log_file, stderr = log_file)
  return(status)
}
dt_to_fst = function(dt, path){
  tmp = tempfile(fileext = ".tsv")
  fwrite(dt, tmp, sep = "\t")
  system2(RSCRIPT, c("-e", shQuote(sprintf(
    "fst::write_fst(data.table::fread('%s', sep = '\\t'), '%s')", tmp, path))))
}
fst_to_dt = function(path){
  tmp = tempfile(fileext = ".tsv")
  system2(RSCRIPT, c("-e", shQuote(sprintf(
    "data.table::fwrite(fst::read_fst('%s'), '%s', sep = '\\t')", path, tmp))))
  return(fread(tmp, sep = "\t"))
}

#- checks registry...
CHECKS = list()
check = function(id, description, condition){
  CHECKS[[length(CHECKS) + 1]] <<- data.table(id = id, check = description, pass = isTRUE(condition))
  if(!isTRUE(condition)) warning("FAILED: [", id, "] ", description)
  invisible(isTRUE(condition))
}
```

# End-to-end run (light dataset)

Light dataset: GSE104556 (2 samples), restricted to `chr17:14-16Mb`
(`tests/data/make_test_data.sh`).

```{r pipeline-run}
#| eval: !expr params$run_pipeline
PIPELINE_LOG = file.path(TMP, "pipeline.log")
#- fresh results directory (cached tasks do not overwrite previously published files)...
unlink(OUTDIR, recursive = TRUE)
start_time = Sys.time()
status = system2(
  "nextflow",
  c("run", PROJECT_DIR, "-profile", "test,conda", "--outdir", OUTDIR, if(params$resume) "-resume"),
  stdout = PIPELINE_LOG, stderr = PIPELINE_LOG,
  env = "NXF_ANSI_LOG=false"
)
message("Duration: ", format(round(difftime(Sys.time(), start_time, units = "mins"), 2)))
check("run", "pipeline (-profile test,conda) completes with exit status 0", status == 0)
if(status != 0) cat(tail(readLines(PIPELINE_LOG), 40), sep = "\n")
```

```{r pipeline-outputs}
SAMPLES = fread("tests/data/light/samplesheet.csv")$sample

for(s in SAMPLES){
  #- probability distribution...
  prob_file = file.path(OUTDIR, "probability", paste0(s, ".prob"))
  check("output", paste0(s, ": probability distribution written"), file.exists(prob_file))
  if(file.exists(prob_file)){
    prob = fread(prob_file, col.names = c("transcriptomic_distance", "counts", "probs_bin"))
    check("output", paste0(s, ": probabilities sum to 100"), abs(sum(prob$probs_bin) - 100) < 1e-6)
  }
  #- EM results...
  check("output", paste0(s, ": EM results written"),
    length(list.files(file.path(OUTDIR, "em"), pattern = paste0("^", s, ".*_em_results.fst$"))) > 0)

  #- iDGE (sparse 10x format)...
  idge_dir = file.path(OUTDIR, "dge", paste0(s, "_iDGE"))
  check("output", paste0(s, ": iDGE directory (10x format) written"),
    all(file.exists(file.path(idge_dir, c("matrix.mtx.gz", "features.tsv.gz", "barcodes.tsv.gz")))))
  if(dir.exists(idge_dir)){
    idge = readMM(file.path(idge_dir, "matrix.mtx.gz"))
    features = fread(file.path(idge_dir, "features.tsv.gz"), header = FALSE)$V1
    barcodes = fread(file.path(idge_dir, "barcodes.tsv.gz"), header = FALSE)$V1
    message(s, " iDGE: ", nrow(idge), " isoforms x ", ncol(idge), " cells, total counts ", round(sum(idge), 2))
    check("output", paste0(s, ": iDGE non-empty, dimensions match features/barcodes"),
      nrow(idge) > 0 & ncol(idge) > 0 & nrow(idge) == length(features) & ncol(idge) == length(barcodes))
    check("output", paste0(s, ": iDGE counts finite & non-negative"), all(is.finite(idge@x)) & all(idge@x >= 0))
    check("output", paste0(s, ": iDGE features are gene***transcript"), all(grepl("\\*\\*\\*", features)))
    #- isoform counts of a quantified gene sum to its Cell Ranger count in each cell (EM abundances rounded to 3 decimals)...
    cr_dir = file.path("tests/data/light/cellranger", s, "outs/filtered_feature_bc_matrix")
    cr = readMM(file.path(cr_dir, "matrix.mtx.gz"))
    rownames(cr) = fread(file.path(cr_dir, "features.tsv.gz"), header = FALSE)$V2
    colnames(cr) = fread(file.path(cr_dir, "barcodes.tsv.gz"), header = FALSE)$V1
    iso = as(idge, "TsparseMatrix")
    iso = data.table(gene_name = sub("\\*\\*\\*.*", "", features[iso@i + 1]), bc = barcodes[iso@j + 1], count = iso@x)[, .(isoform_sum = sum(count)), by = .(gene_name, bc)]
    iso = iso[gene_name %in% rownames(cr) & bc %in% colnames(cr)]
    iso[, cr_count := cr[cbind(match(gene_name, rownames(cr)), match(bc, colnames(cr)))]]
    check("output", paste0(s, ": isoform counts sum to the gene count in each cell x gene (", nrow(iso), ")"),
      nrow(iso) > 0 & all(abs(iso$isoform_sum - iso$cr_count) <= 0.005 * iso$cr_count))
  }
}
```

# Regression tests (plasslab/SCALPEL issues)

## #34 — `probability_distribution.R` with one-sided distances

Synthetic single-isoform genes whose transcriptomic distances are all positive
(the case that crashed with `wrong sign in 'by' argument`), then mixed signs.

```{r issue-34}
set.seed(34)
for(scenario in c("positive_only", "mixed_signs")){
  repo = file.path(TMP, paste0("issue34_", scenario))
  dir.create(repo, showWarnings = FALSE)
  #- 20 single-isoform genes, 5-60 reads each...
  reads = rbindlist(lapply(1:20, function(g){
    nb_reads = sample(5:60, 1)
    data.table(
      seqnames = "chr1", read_start = g * 1e4 + seq_len(nb_reads) * 10, strand = "+",
      tags = paste0("BC", seq_len(nb_reads), "::UMI", g),
      gene_name = paste0("G", g), transcript_name = paste0("G", g, "-201"),
      start.rdR = if(scenario == "positive_only") sample(15:450, nb_reads, TRUE) else sample(-80:450, nb_reads, TRUE)
    )
  }))
  reads$read_end = reads$read_start + 90
  dt_to_fst(reads, file.path(repo, "S1_chr1.ip_filtered.fst"))
  status = run_rscript(c(
    file.path(BIN_IQ, "probability_distribution.R"), "--repo", repo, "--gene_frac", "98%", "--bins", "20",
    "--threads", "1", "--OUTPUT_PROB", file.path(repo, "S1.prob"), "--OUTPUT_PDF", file.path(repo, "S1.pdf")
  ), file.path(repo, "log.txt"))
  check("#34", paste0("probability_distribution.R succeeds (", scenario, ")"), status == 0)
  if(status == 0){
    prob = fread(file.path(repo, "S1.prob"), col.names = c("transcriptomic_distance", "counts", "probs_bin"))
    check("#34", paste0("probabilities sum to 100 (", scenario, ")"), abs(sum(prob$probs_bin) - 100) < 1e-6)
    check("#34", paste0("distance axis covers observed reads (", scenario, ")"),
      min(prob$transcriptomic_distance) <= min(reads$start.rdR) & max(prob$transcriptomic_distance) >= max(reads$start.rdR) - 1)
  } else {
    cat(readLines(file.path(repo, "log.txt")), sep = "\n")
  }
}
```

## #37 — reads filters #a and #c (original strict behaviour)

Three fragments on the `+` strand, two genes (`G1`: isoforms `TA`, `TB`; `G2`: `TC`):

| fragment | reads | expected |
|---|---|---|
| `bc1::u1` | in `TA` only + in `TA`&`TB` | keep `TA`, drop `TB` (filter c) |
| `bc2::u2` | in `TA` only + in `TC` only | drop all — no transcript has all reads (filter c) |
| `bc3::u3` | in `TA`&`TB` + intergenic | drop all (filter a) |

```{r issue-37}
repo = file.path(TMP, "issue37")
dir.create(repo, showWarnings = FALSE)

#- annotation (exon 1 = 3' most exon)...
annots = data.table(
  seqnames = "chr1", start = c(1000, 1500, 3000), end = c(2000, 2000, 4000), strand = "+",
  startR = 0, endR = c(1000, 500, 1000),
  gene_name = c("G1", "G1", "G2"), transcript_name = c("TA", "TB", "TC"),
  exon_number = 1L, TPM_perc = c(0.5, 0.5, 1)
)
fwrite(annots, file.path(repo, "annots.tsv"), sep = "\t")

#- reads (bam2bed --split layout: tags in columns 14-15)...
reads = data.table(
  V1 = "chr1",
  V2 = c(1100, 1800, 1100, 3100, 1800, 6000),
  V3 = c(1200, 1900, 1200, 3200, 1900, 6100),
  V4 = paste0("r", 1:6), V5 = 255, V6 = "+"
)
for(i in 7:13) reads[[paste0("V", i)]] = "."
reads$V14 = paste0("CB:Z:", c("bc1", "bc1", "bc2", "bc2", "bc3", "bc3"))
reads$V15 = paste0("UB:Z:", c("u1", "u1", "u2", "u2", "u3", "u3"))
fwrite(reads, file.path(repo, "reads.bed"), sep = "\t", col.names = FALSE)

status = run_rscript(c(
  file.path(BIN_RP, "reads_mapping_and_filtering.R"), "--reads", file.path(repo, "reads.bed"),
  "--annotations", file.path(repo, "annots.tsv"), "--output", file.path(repo, "out.fst"),
  "--distance_threshold", "5000"
), file.path(repo, "log.txt"))
check("#37", "reads_mapping_and_filtering.R succeeds", status == 0)

if(status == 0){
  kept = unique(fst_to_dt(file.path(repo, "out.fst"))[, .(tags, transcript_name)])
  kept$pair = paste(kept$tags, kept$transcript_name)
  print(kept)
  check("#37", "bc1::u1 — TA kept (covers all reads)", "CB:Z:bc1::UB:Z:u1 TA" %in% kept$pair)
  check("#37", "bc1::u1 — TB dropped (misses one read, filter c)", !("CB:Z:bc1::UB:Z:u1 TB" %in% kept$pair))
  check("#37", "bc2::u2 — dropped (no transcript has all reads, filter c)", !any(grepl("bc2", kept$tags)))
  check("#37", "bc3::u3 — dropped (intergenic read, filter a)", !any(grepl("bc3", kept$tags)))
} else {
  cat(readLines(file.path(repo, "log.txt")), sep = "\n")
}
```

## Fragment agreement — one disagreeing read drops the fragment from that isoform

Synthetic fragments of 2 reads: both agree with isoform X, one disagrees with isoform Y
(crosses Y's exon boundary, spliced at another donor, spliced on an exon absent from Y,
> 600 nt from Y's 3' end). Expected: kept on X, dropped from Y; control fragments compatible
with both isoforms are kept on both (`tests/unit/read_agreement_test.R`).

```{r fragment-agreement}
out_dir = file.path(TMP, "read_agreement")
status = run_rscript(c("tests/unit/read_agreement_test.R", file.path(BIN_RP, "reads_mapping_and_filtering.R"), out_dir), file.path(TMP, "read_agreement.log"))
check("agreement", "read agreement test runs", status == 0)
if(status == 0){
  res = fread(file.path(out_dir, "checks.tsv"))
  for(i in seq_len(nrow(res))) check("agreement", res$case[i], res$result[i] == "PASS")
} else {
  cat(readLines(file.path(TMP, "read_agreement.log")), sep = "\n")
}
```

## Internal priming — original SCALPEL rule

For each isoform, the internal priming site closest to its 3' end (>= `--distance_ip`) is
located on its exons, and every fragment lying entirely upstream of it is discarded, on both
strands (`tests/unit/internal_priming_test.R`).

```{r internal-priming}
out_dir = file.path(TMP, "internal_priming")
status = run_rscript(c("tests/unit/internal_priming_test.R", file.path(BIN_RP, "ip_filtering.R"), out_dir), file.path(TMP, "internal_priming.log"))
check("ip", "internal priming test runs", status == 0)
if(status == 0){
  res = fread(file.path(out_dir, "checks.tsv"))
  for(i in seq_len(nrow(res))) check("ip", res$case[i], res$result[i] == "PASS")
} else {
  cat(readLines(file.path(TMP, "internal_priming.log")), sep = "\n")
}
```

## Internal priming reference — generation from the genome

Without `--ip_reference`, internal priming sites are detected on the genome (10 nt windows with
>= 7 A or starting with 6 A, overlapping windows merged, trimmed to the first A; same rule on T
for the `-` strand), as in the SCALPEL mm10/hg38 references (`tests/unit/ip_reference_test.R`).

```{r ip-reference}
out_dir = file.path(TMP, "ip_reference")
status = run_rscript(c("tests/unit/ip_reference_test.R", file.path(BIN_RP, "ip_reference_generation.R"), out_dir), file.path(TMP, "ip_reference.log"))
check("ip_ref", "internal priming reference test runs", status == 0)
if(status == 0){
  res = fread(file.path(out_dir, "checks.tsv"))
  for(i in seq_len(nrow(res))) check("ip_ref", res$case[i], res$result[i] == "PASS")
} else {
  cat(readLines(file.path(TMP, "ip_reference.log")), sep = "\n")
}
```

## Isoform collapsing (3' end profile)

Isoforms whose 3' ends are within `--distance_3end` and whose exons are identical (genomic splice
sites) within `--distance_profile` of the furthest 3' end are collapsed; the representative (highest
TPM) is extended to the furthest 3' end of its group, as in the original SCALPEL
(`tests/unit/isoform_collapsing_test.R`).

```{r isoform-collapsing}
out_dir = file.path(TMP, "isoform_collapsing")
status = run_rscript(c("tests/unit/isoform_collapsing_test.R", file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "subworkflows/local/annotation_processing/bin/isoform_selection.R"), out_dir), file.path(TMP, "isoform_collapsing.log"))
check("collapse", "isoform collapsing test runs", status == 0)
if(status == 0){
  res = fread(file.path(out_dir, "checks.tsv"))
  for(i in seq_len(nrow(res))) check("collapse", res$case[i], res$result[i] == "PASS")
} else {
  cat(readLines(file.path(TMP, "isoform_collapsing.log")), sep = "\n")
}
```

## EM run to convergence

With the original stopping rule (abundance change < 0.01, 30 iterations), the EM stops before an
isoform that is never the best explanation of any fragment reaches 0. The EM now runs to
convergence by default (`--em_tol 1e-6`, `--em_max_iter 1000`); the original settings remain
available (`tests/unit/em_convergence_test.R`).

```{r em-convergence}
out_dir = file.path(TMP, "em_convergence")
status = run_rscript(c("tests/unit/em_convergence_test.R", file.path(BIN_IQ, "em_algorithm.R"), out_dir), file.path(TMP, "em_convergence.log"))
check("em", "EM convergence test runs", status == 0)
if(status == 0){
  res = fread(file.path(out_dir, "checks.tsv"))
  for(i in seq_len(nrow(res))) check("em", res$case[i], res$result[i] == "PASS")
} else {
  cat(readLines(file.path(TMP, "em_convergence.log")), sep = "\n")
}
```

## Differential isoform usage tests

Simulated cells whose isoform usage varies from cell to cell (Dirichlet) with UMIs per cell ~ Poisson
(`tests/unit/diu_test.R`). The original pseudobulk X2 test (`--diu_test chisq`) treats UMIs as
independent observations; the permutation test (`--diu_test permutation`) permutes the cells between
the compared groups (within samples when clusters are compared). Also checked: BH adjustment once per
gene, usage change / 3' end shift, `--diu_min_delta`, comparisons with more than 2 groups.

```{r diu-tests}
out_dir = file.path(TMP, "diu")
status = run_rscript(c("tests/unit/diu_test.R", file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "subworkflows/local/apa_characterization/bin/differential_isoform_usage_functions.R"), out_dir), file.path(TMP, "diu.log"))
check("diu", "DIU test runs", status == 0 | file.exists(file.path(out_dir, "checks.tsv")))
if(file.exists(file.path(out_dir, "checks.tsv"))){
  res = fread(file.path(out_dir, "checks.tsv"))
  for(i in seq_len(nrow(res))) check("diu", res$check[i], isTRUE(res$pass[i]))
} else {
  cat(readLines(file.path(TMP, "diu.log")), sep = "\n")
}
```

## #38 / #28 — iDGE beyond R's integer limit

50,000 cells x 50,000 isoforms (dense: 2.5e9 entries > `.Machine$integer.max`),
very sparse so the test stays fast. The former `pivot_wider` overflowed on such shapes.

```{r issue-38}
repo = file.path(TMP, "issue38")
dir.create(file.path(repo, "dge"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
N_CELLS = 50000
N_GENES = 25000
set.seed(38)

#- DGE: one expressed gene per cell...
bcs = sprintf("CELL%06d-1", 1:N_CELLS)
genes = sprintf("G%05d", 1:N_GENES)
gene_idx = sample.int(N_GENES, N_CELLS, replace = TRUE)
counts = rpois(N_CELLS, 4) + 1
writeMM(sparseMatrix(i = gene_idx, j = 1:N_CELLS, x = counts, dims = c(N_GENES, N_CELLS)), file.path(repo, "dge/matrix.mtx"))
R.utils::gzip(file.path(repo, "dge/matrix.mtx"), overwrite = TRUE)
fwrite(data.table(genes, genes, "Gene Expression"), file.path(repo, "dge/features.tsv.gz"), sep = "\t", col.names = FALSE)
fwrite(data.table(bcs), file.path(repo, "dge/barcodes.tsv.gz"), col.names = FALSE)

#- EM predictions: 2 isoforms for every gene (50,000 isoforms in total)...
preds = data.table(bc_gene = rep(1:N_CELLS, each = 2), bc = rep(bcs, each = 2), gene_name = rep(genes[gene_idx], each = 2))
preds$transcript_name = paste0(preds$gene_name, rep(c("-201", "-202"), N_CELLS))
preds$rel_abund = rep(c(0.7, 0.3), N_CELLS)
extra = data.table(bc_gene = 0L, bc = bcs[1], gene_name = genes, rel_abund = 0)
extra = rbind(copy(extra)[, transcript_name := paste0(gene_name, "-201")], copy(extra)[, transcript_name := paste0(gene_name, "-202")])
preds = rbind(preds, extra[, names(preds), with = FALSE])
dt_to_fst(preds, file.path(repo, "S1_em_results.fst"))
message("dense size: ", format(N_CELLS * uniqueN(preds$transcript_name), big.mark = ","),
  " (> integer max: ", N_CELLS * uniqueN(preds$transcript_name) > .Machine$integer.max, ")")

start_time = Sys.time()
status = run_rscript(c(
  file.path(BIN_IQ, "dge_generation.R"), "--dge", file.path(repo, "dge"), "--pred", repo,
  "--output", file.path(repo, "S1_iDGE")
), file.path(repo, "log.txt"))
message("dge_generation.R: ", format(round(difftime(Sys.time(), start_time, units = "secs"), 1)))
check("#38", "dge_generation.R succeeds beyond the integer limit", status == 0)

if(status == 0){
  idge = readMM(file.path(repo, "S1_iDGE/matrix.mtx.gz"))
  check("#38", "iDGE dimensions = 50,000 isoforms x 50,000 cells", all(dim(idge) == c(2 * N_GENES, N_CELLS)))
  check("#38", "iDGE total = sum(rel_abund x gene counts)", abs(sum(idge) - sum(counts)) < 1e-6)
} else {
  cat(readLines(file.path(repo, "log.txt")), sep = "\n")
}
```

## #29 — samplesheet paths are checked early

A missing file must stop the run immediately with an explicit message
(instead of silently skipping processes).

```{r issue-29}
bad_sheet = file.path(TMP, "bad_samplesheet.csv")
fwrite(data.table(
  sample = "S1", fastq_1 = "missing_R1.fastq.gz", fastq_2 = "missing_R2.fastq.gz", cranger_path = "missing_dir"
), bad_sheet)
log_file = file.path(TMP, "bad_samplesheet.log")
status = system2(
  "nextflow",
  c("run", PROJECT_DIR, "-profile", "test,conda", "--outdir", file.path(TMP, "bad_out"), "--samplesheet", bad_sheet),
  stdout = log_file, stderr = log_file, env = "NXF_ANSI_LOG=false"
)
check("#29", "run fails on missing samplesheet file", status != 0)
check("#29", "explicit 'Samplesheet error' message", any(grepl("Samplesheet error", readLines(log_file))))
```

# Scenarios (inputs, checks, clusters, fixed annotation)

Each scenario is a separate `-resume` run on the light dataset (cached steps are reused).

```{r scenario-inputs}
#| eval: !expr params$scenarios
SCEN = file.path(TMP, "scenarios")
dir.create(SCEN, showWarnings = FALSE)
LIGHT = normalizePath("tests/data/light")

#- STARsolo layout for SRR6129050 (no BAM index, plain count files)...
star_dir = file.path(SCEN, "starsolo/SRR6129050")
dir.create(file.path(star_dir, "Solo.out/Gene/filtered"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
file.copy(file.path(LIGHT, "cellranger/SRR6129050/outs/possorted_genome_bam.bam"), file.path(star_dir, "Aligned.sortedByCoord.out.bam"), overwrite = TRUE)
for(f in c("matrix.mtx", "features.tsv", "barcodes.tsv")){
  writeLines(readLines(gzfile(file.path(LIGHT, "cellranger/SRR6129050/outs/filtered_feature_bc_matrix", paste0(f, ".gz")))),
    file.path(star_dir, "Solo.out/Gene/filtered", f))
}

#- Cell Ranger ARC multiome layout for SRR6129051 (gex_possorted_bam.bam + ATAC Peaks features)...
arc_dir = file.path(SCEN, "arc/SRR6129051/outs")
dir.create(file.path(arc_dir, "filtered_feature_bc_matrix"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
src = file.path(LIGHT, "cellranger/SRR6129051/outs")
file.copy(file.path(src, "possorted_genome_bam.bam"), file.path(arc_dir, "gex_possorted_bam.bam"), overwrite = TRUE)
file.copy(file.path(src, "possorted_genome_bam.bam.bai"), file.path(arc_dir, "gex_possorted_bam.bam.bai"), overwrite = TRUE)
gex = readMM(file.path(src, "filtered_feature_bc_matrix/matrix.mtx.gz"))
feats = fread(file.path(src, "filtered_feature_bc_matrix/features.tsv.gz"), header = FALSE)
nb_peaks = 50
peaks = data.table(V1 = paste0("chr17:", 1e6 + 1:nb_peaks * 1000, "-", 1e6 + 1:nb_peaks * 1000 + 500), V2 = NA, V3 = "Peaks")
peaks$V2 = peaks$V1
writeMM(rbind(gex, Matrix::rsparsematrix(nb_peaks, ncol(gex), 0.05, rand.x = function(n) rpois(n, 3) + 1)), file.path(arc_dir, "filtered_feature_bc_matrix/matrix.mtx"))
R.utils::gzip(file.path(arc_dir, "filtered_feature_bc_matrix/matrix.mtx"), overwrite = TRUE)
fwrite(rbind(feats, peaks), file.path(arc_dir, "filtered_feature_bc_matrix/features.tsv.gz"), sep = "\t", col.names = FALSE)
file.copy(file.path(src, "filtered_feature_bc_matrix/barcodes.tsv.gz"), file.path(arc_dir, "filtered_feature_bc_matrix/barcodes.tsv.gz"), overwrite = TRUE)

layouts_sheet = file.path(SCEN, "samplesheet_layouts.csv")
fwrite(data.table(
  sample = c("SRR6129050", "SRR6129051"),
  fastq_1 = file.path(LIGHT, "reads", c("SRR6129050_R1.fastq.gz", "SRR6129051_R1.fastq.gz")),
  fastq_2 = file.path(LIGHT, "reads", c("SRR6129050_R2.fastq.gz", "SRR6129051_R2.fastq.gz")),
  cranger_path = c(star_dir, dirname(arc_dir))
), layouts_sheet)

res = run_pipeline("layouts", c(), layouts_sheet)
check("#22/#30", "run with STARsolo + multiome layouts completes", res$status == 0)
if(res$status == 0){
  check("#22", "STARsolo layout: iDGE identical to Cell Ranger layout",
    same_idge(file.path(res$outdir, "dge/SRR6129050_iDGE"), file.path(OUTDIR, "dge/SRR6129050_iDGE")))
  check("#30", "multiome layout: Peaks discarded, iDGE identical to GEX-only",
    same_idge(file.path(res$outdir, "dge/SRR6129051_iDGE"), file.path(OUTDIR, "dge/SRR6129051_iDGE")))
} else {
  cat(tail(res$log, 30), sep = "\n")
}
```


```{r scenario-clusters}
#| eval: !expr params$scenarios
#- clusters from the baseline cells: 2 clusters per sample (header present)...
seurat_cells = rbindlist(lapply(SAMPLES, function(s){
  bcs = fread(file.path(OUTDIR, "dge", paste0(s, "_iDGE/barcodes.tsv.gz")), header = FALSE)$V1
  data.table(sample = s, barcode = bcs, cluster = ifelse(seq_along(bcs) %% 2 == 0, "clusterA", "clusterB"))
}))
clusters_ok = file.path(SCEN, "clusters.tsv")
fwrite(seurat_cells, clusters_ok, sep = "\t")

res = run_pipeline("clusters", c("--clusters", clusters_ok))
check("#32", "run with --clusters completes", res$status == 0)
if(res$status == 0){
  diu = fread(file.path(res$outdir, "differential/DIU_table.csv"))
  check("#32", "DIU table compares the clusters (clusterA, clusterB)", all(c("clusterA", "clusterB") %in% colnames(diu)))
}

#- permutation test on the same clusters (cells permuted within samples)...
res = run_pipeline("diu_permutation", c("--clusters", clusters_ok, "--diu_test", "permutation", "--diu_permutations", "2000"))
check("diu", "run with --diu_test permutation completes", res$status == 0)
if(res$status == 0){
  diu = fread(file.path(res$outdir, "differential/DIU_table.csv"))
  check("diu", "permutation DIU table: test column, p-values from cell permutations (n_perm)",
    all(diu$test == "permutation") & any(!is.na(diu$n_perm)) & all(diu$p.value >= 1 / 2001, na.rm = TRUE))
}

#- clusters file with barcodes that do not match (e.g. missing '-1' suffix)...
clusters_bad = file.path(SCEN, "clusters_bad.tsv")
fwrite(seurat_cells[, .(sample, barcode = sub("-1$", "", barcode), cluster)], clusters_bad, sep = "\t")
res = run_pipeline("clusters_bad", c("--clusters", clusters_bad))
check("#32", "non-matching clusters file stops with an explicit message",
  res$status != 0 & any(grepl("No cell of the clusters file matches", res$log)))
```

```{r scenario-runs}
#| eval: !expr params$scenarios
#- several runs (FASTQ pairs) of one sample (#18): SRR6129050 split in two runs...
runs_dir = file.path(TMP, "runs"); dir.create(runs_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
for(r in c("R1", "R2")){
  fq = readLines(gzfile(file.path(LIGHT, "reads", paste0("SRR6129050_", r, ".fastq.gz"))))
  half = 4 * floor(length(fq) / 8)
  writeLines(fq[seq_len(half)], gzfile(file.path(runs_dir, paste0("run1_", r, ".fastq.gz"))))
  writeLines(fq[(half + 1):length(fq)], gzfile(file.path(runs_dir, paste0("run2_", r, ".fastq.gz"))))
}
cr = normalizePath(file.path(LIGHT, "cellranger"))
rd = normalizePath(file.path(LIGHT, "reads"))
runs_sheet = file.path(runs_dir, "samplesheet.csv")
writeLines(c("sample,fastq_1,fastq_2,cranger_path",
  paste("SRR6129050", file.path(runs_dir, "run1_R1.fastq.gz"), file.path(runs_dir, "run1_R2.fastq.gz"), file.path(cr, "SRR6129050"), sep = ","),
  paste("SRR6129050", file.path(runs_dir, "run2_R1.fastq.gz"), file.path(runs_dir, "run2_R2.fastq.gz"), file.path(cr, "SRR6129050"), sep = ","),
  paste("SRR6129051", file.path(rd, "SRR6129051_R1.fastq.gz"), file.path(rd, "SRR6129051_R2.fastq.gz"), file.path(cr, "SRR6129051"), sep = ",")), runs_sheet)
res = run_pipeline("runs", c(), runs_sheet)
check("#18", "sample with several runs (FASTQ pairs) completes", res$status == 0)
if(res$status == 0){
  meta_info = function(dir){
    info = readLines(file.path(dir, "salmon", "SRR6129050", "aux_info", "meta_info.json"))
    return(trimws(grep('"num_processed"|"num_mapped"', info, value = TRUE)))
  }
  check("#18", "salmon quantifies all runs of the sample (same reads processed & mapped as the single run)",
    identical(meta_info(res$outdir), meta_info(OUTDIR)))
}
#- rows of one sample pointing to different Cell Ranger outputs...
bad_sheet = file.path(runs_dir, "samplesheet_bad.csv")
writeLines(c(readLines(runs_sheet)[1:2], sub(file.path(cr, "SRR6129050"), file.path(cr, "SRR6129051"), readLines(runs_sheet)[3], fixed = TRUE), readLines(runs_sheet)[4]), bad_sheet)
res = run_pipeline("runs_bad", c(), bad_sheet)
check("#18", "runs of one sample with different cranger_path -> explicit error", res$status != 0 && any(grepl("must share the same cranger_path", res$log)))
```

```{r scenario-ip-reference}
#| eval: !expr params$scenarios
#- default: internal priming reference generated from --genome (baseline run)...
#- (the log lists the submitted tasks only: with -resume the task can be cached, its output is still published)...
check("ip_ref", "baseline run: internal priming reference generated from --genome",
  file.exists(file.path(OUTDIR, "ip_reference", "ip_reference.track.gz")) & !any(grepl("--ip_reference", readLines(PIPELINE_LOG), fixed = TRUE)))
gen_file = file.path(OUTDIR, "ip_reference", "ip_reference.track.gz")
check("ip_ref", "generated reference published (ip_reference/ip_reference.track.gz)", file.exists(gen_file))
ref_file = normalizePath("tests/data/light/annotations/polya.track.gz")
if(file.exists(gen_file)){
  cols = c("seqnames", "start", "end", "V4", "V5", "strand")
  gen = fread(cmd = paste("gzip -dc", gen_file), header = FALSE, col.names = cols)
  ref = fread(cmd = paste("gzip -dc", ref_file), header = FALSE, col.names = cols)
  gen = gen[start >= min(ref$start) & end <= max(ref$end)]
  nb_shared = nrow(fintersect(gen[, .(seqnames, start, end, strand)], ref[, .(seqnames, start, end, strand)]))
  message("Generated sites: ", nrow(gen), " | SCALPEL mm10 reference: ", nrow(ref), " | identical: ", nb_shared)
  check("ip_ref", ">= 99.5% of the SCALPEL mm10 reference sites generated identically", nb_shared / nrow(ref) >= 0.995)
}
#- pre-built reference (SCALPEL mm10 track, --ip_reference)...
res = run_pipeline("ip_prebuilt", c("--ip_reference", ref_file))
check("ip_ref", "run with a pre-built --ip_reference completes", res$status == 0)
check("ip_ref", "pre-built reference used (IP_SPLITTING, no generation)", any(grepl("IP_SPLITTING", res$log)) && !any(grepl("IP_REFERENCE_GENERATION", res$log)))
if(res$status == 0){
  for(s in SAMPLES){
    check("ip_ref", paste0(s, ": iDGE identical with generated & pre-built (SCALPEL mm10) references"),
      same_idge(file.path(res$outdir, "dge", paste0(s, "_iDGE")), file.path(OUTDIR, "dge", paste0(s, "_iDGE"))))
  }
}
#- neither --ip_reference nor --genome...
no_genome_config = file.path(TMP, "no_genome.config")
writeLines(c("params {", "    genome = null", "}"), no_genome_config)
res = run_pipeline("ip_missing", c("-c", no_genome_config))
check("ip_ref", "no --ip_reference and no --genome -> explicit error", res$status != 0 && any(grepl("--ip_reference or --genome is required", res$log)))
```

# Summary

```{r summary}
CHECKS = rbindlist(CHECKS)
knitr::kable(CHECKS[, .(issue = id, check, result = ifelse(pass, "PASS", "FAIL"))])
message(sum(CHECKS$pass), "/", nrow(CHECKS), " checks passed")
```
